ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white and cream pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the visible fluke surface, with high-contrast low-intensity black pixels confined to the trailing edge and lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white central region; localized dark focal spots observed on the medial-right lobe surface; brownish-yellow tinting concentrated near the center-left lobe; black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the trailing edge and outer lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with approximately 40-50 degree divergence; depth of notch is approximately 1/10th of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of variations is most pronounced at the distal ends of both lobes, exhibiting a jagged, saw-tooth morphology.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular dark pixel clusters visible on the mid-right lobe and several small dark spots on the lower-left lobe interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Minimal visible rake marks; faint vertical linear disruptions present on the mid-right lobe surface near the dark focal spots.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep jagged irregularities and missing tissue segments on the upper trailing edge of both the left and right lobes, particularly prominent at the terminal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian subject in flight in the upper-left quadrant and text-based watermark '© Dr. Artie Kopelman for CRESLI' in the lower margin.
